# mDNSShark

> mDNSShark is a free, open-source iPhone app (iOS 18.2+) that shows what is on your local network. It uses mDNS (Bonjour/DNS-SD) and SSDP to discover printers, media servers, smart TVs, IoT gadgets and other services on your Wi-Fi, flags risky exposed services, and captures network traffic. Scans and analysis run on the phone, and the app has no telemetry, analytics or trackers. Developer: ShapeHaven Innovations LLC. License: MIT.

## Features

- Device discovery: Bonjour/mDNS (DNS-SD) and SSDP, optional /24 subnet scan for services that don't broadcast, and OUI lookups that name the manufacturer.
- Security assessment: flags risky exposed services and checks manufacturers against CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog and the NVD. Findings export as a plain-text report.
- Packet capture: DNS and SNI visibility through a local packet tunnel, with pcap export for Wireshark.
- TLS Inspection (optional subscription, $1.99/month, 3-day free trial): a local HTTPS proxy that decrypts and logs HTTPS traffic for analysis, with the user's consent.
